flagged.title: Sea Level Change and Drowned Forests
flagged.reason: The video repeats the 2,000-year date error (6,500 years ago instead of 8,500 years ago / 6500 BCE) for Britain becoming an island, and misstates the Devensian Last Glacial Maximum limit as the Thames-Severn line.

mark_affecting.quote: Fast forward to about 6,500 years ago, and Doggerland flooded completely, severing the land bridge and turning Britain into an island.
...and Britain, basically north of the Thames-Severn line.

flagged.title: Atmospheric Carbon Dioxide and Climate Feedbacks
flagged.reason: The video states that plants have 'fewer stomata open' under high CO2 (03:59), conflating short-term stomatal aperture with developmental stomatal density, which would cost marks on a GCSE question about fossil leaf proxies.

mark_affecting.quote: Because a plant needs fewer stomata open when atmospheric CO2 levels are nice and high.
